name: io.github.chrischall/housecallpro-mcp
description: Read Housecall Pro estimates from the customer link your contractor sent you.

environmentVariables.name: HOUSECALLPRO_LINK
environmentVariables.description: Estimate or invoice link your contractor sent you.

environmentVariables.name: HOUSECALLPRO_LINKS
environmentVariables.description: A JSON array of customer links for several documents at once. Use HOUSECALLPRO_LINK instead for a single estimate/invoice link.

environmentVariables.name: HOUSECALLPRO_LINK_LABEL
environmentVariables.description: Label for the single link given by HOUSECALLPRO_LINK (defaults to "default").
